title: Lane Kiffin on his haltfime wisecrack: "Everybody hates you. They can't hate you much more."

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Lane Kiffin on his haltfime wisecrack: "Everybody hates you. They can't hate you much more."
sources.description: At halftime of Saturday night's 51-10 blowout win over Clemson, when LSU won 31-3, Tigers coach Lane Kiffin capped an on-field interview by saying, "Imagine if we had pro players."
